Content: Spacecraft sometimes use a nuclear power source that produces electricity from the heat released by the decay of radioisotopes. `text(Two)` radioisotopes that have been used in these nuclear power sources are `text(plutonium-238)` and `text(americium-241)`. Both the `text(Pu-238)` and `text(Am-241)` emit alpha radiation and gamma radiation. The `text(half-life)` of `text(Am-241)` is `text(432.7 years)`. Other sources of electrical energy for some spacecraft have been solar panels and batteries.
